elements.aside: Use Aside (ui-public/Aside): it needs a label, the name of the complementary content for screen readers.
elements.nav: Use Nav (ui-public/Nav): it needs a label, the name of the navigation for screen readers.
elements.main: Use Main (ui-public/Main): it gives the id of the skip link.
elements.section: Do not use section. Without a name it is not a landmark. With a name, each section is a landmark and makes noise in the landmark list of a screen reader. Use a div with a Heading. Use Aside, Nav or Main for a real landmark of the page.
elements.img: Use Image (ui-public/Image): it needs an alt, the text for screen readers. Write alt="" for a decoration.
elements.button: Use Button (ui-public/Button) for a button with the look of a button, or RawButton (ui-public/RawButton) for a button with its own look.
